  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ
  Ummat-e-jad ke bigre kaam banaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

  1
  Kehti thi Zainab ae baaba koi sahaara ab na raha
  Jaan ke tanha ahl-e-sitam kheme jalaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

  2
  Dhup hai jalta sehra hai baap ka dil khun hota hai
  Nanhe mujaahid ummat ka kaam banaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

  3
  Ro ke Sakina ne kaha ye bahr-e-madad aao daada
  Zaalim mere baaba ko naize lagaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

  4
  Gir chuke Akbar ghore se Shaah ka saathi koi nahiṅ
  Tuti kamar ko pakre hue laash uthaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

  5
  Bano ne ro kar kaha hashr hua Aabid barpa
  Jalte haiṅ khaime dushman-e-din qaidi banaane aaye haiṅ
  Karb o Bala meiṅ Shaah-e-zamaan ghar ko lutaane aaye haiṅ

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/karb-o-bala-mein-shaah-e-zamaan.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
opening, header, body = original.split(b'---\\n', 2)
roman = header.decode()
changes = {
    'Shaah-e-zamaan': 'Shaah-e-Zamaan',
    'Ummat-e-jad': 'Ummat-e-jadd',
    'Zainab ae baaba': 'Zainab, ae baaba',
    'ahl-e-sitam kheme': 'ahl-e-sitam khaime',
    'jalta sehra': 'jalta sahra',
    'kaha ye bahr-e-madad': 'kaha ye, bahr-e-madad',
    'kaha hashr hua Aabid barpa': 'kaha, hashr hua Aabid barpa',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)

roman_blocks = roman.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].strip().split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 6
for index, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines) == 3 + bool(index)
    if index:
        assert roman_lines[0].strip() == str(index)
        assert source_lines[0] == '۰۱۲۳۴۵'[index]
updated = b'---\\n'.join((opening, roman.encode(), body))
assert updated.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == body
path.write_bytes(updated)
PY
